text:
Aiden: Heads up — seeing ~12% drop in dedup token-saved for /v1/stream-chat (rdx-3b-q4) for two tenants since ~02:00 UTC :thinking:
Priya: Link? what window are you comparing? :eyes:
Aiden: Comparing 24h vs previous 24h, grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/cache-metrics?orgId=1&var-route=/v1/stream-chat
Aiden: Query I used (promql):
```
sum by (customer) (increase(kv_cache_tokens_saved_total{route="/v1/stream-chat",model="rdx-3b-q4"}[24h]))
/ sum by (customer) (increase(request_tokens_total{route="/v1/stream-chat",model="rdx-3b-q4"}[24h]))
```
Marco: Did we roll any key-normalizer or hashing changes last night? I remember PR #4572 touched key hashing for perf micro-optimizations.
srek: We deployed kernel-selection + batching tweak at 01:30, but that PR didn't touch canonicalization. There *was* a tiny change in the key normalizer lib (eng-runtime@01a2b3) that trims quotes differently — could affect punctuation-heavy prompts.
anna: Quick sample from tenant slice shows a lot of keys differing only by trailing punctuation and cap variants — e.g., "Summarize: foo." vs "Summarize: foo". Those became distinct cache entries. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/shot/xyz.png
Priya: If normalization loosened/changed order, hit shape could fragment. Can you paste the normalizer diff?
Aiden: small snippet from the running binary stack (stripped):
```
// normalizer: collapse whitespace, strip outer quotes, preserve first punctuation
s = collapse_ws(s)
if (s.starts_with('"') && s.ends_with('"')) s = s[1:-1]
// OLD: drop trailing punctuation after quote-strip
// NEW: preserve trailing punctuation to keep original tokens
```
srek: Yep that's the change — intended to keep fidelity for evals but exploded key entropy for short prompts.
perf-bot: ALERT: cache-hitrate-regression route=/v1/stream-chat model=rdx-3b-q4 magnitude=12% window=24h
Marco: Oof. That matches tenant spikes. What's the best mitigation? rollback normalizer change? add a temporary canonicalization layer for caching only?
anna: I ran a quick offline join: if we canonicalize by lowercasing + strip trailing punctuation + collapse ws, estimated recovered token-saved ~9.5% for affected tenants. I can push a config-only fix in ~30m to the cache key pipeline (no runtime binary change).
Priya: Prefer config-only immediate mitigation + postmortem. Owner?
Aiden: I can do the config patch and a short canary (10% traffic) — will monitor token-saved and latency.
srek: Make sure we also test for unintended merges (we don't want to conflate prompts where punctuation matters). Add a small sampling probe that retains raw keys for 1% of requests for downstream QA.
Marco: Also capture a histogram of tokens-saved per-key before/after so we can show impact per-customer. Add panel: tokens_saved_by_normalized_vs_raw (per-customer, per-model).
anna: I'll add the panel and a data export job to sample affected keys for 48h. Export CSV with columns: customer, route, model, raw_key, norm_key, requests, tokens_saved.
Priya: Filing follow-ups: 1) config patch rollout (Aiden) 2) sampling + export (anna) 3) postmortem + root cause (Marco) 4) decision on permanent normalizer rules (eng + product). I'll create the ticket and tag owners.
Aiden: Pushing config now, canary to 10% at 2245006825 UTC. Will report back in ~10m. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: NOTE: canary_change: key-normalizer-config applied to 10% traffic for route=/v1/stream-chat by user=Aiden
Aiden: Canary looks good so far — token-saved trending back up toward baseline, latency unchanged.
Priya: Great. After canary, schedule 1h full rollout + postmortem writeup. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
